title: BLIP Captioner Observability
description: DA3408 A4: CPU image-captioning app health, throughput, latency, clients and VM resources.

panels.title: App status
panels.description: Is Prometheus able to scrape the captioning app's /metrics endpoint? UP = 1, DOWN = 0.

panels.title: Node exporter status
panels.description: Is the system metrics exporter on the VM reachable? UP = 1, DOWN = 0.

panels.title: Model status
panels.description: Which captioning model is loaded and on which device. The Info metric is set only after the model finishes loading at app startup.

panels.title: Images captioned (15 min)
panels.description: Successful captions across Single and Bulk modes in the last 15 minutes.

panels.title: Error rate (5 min)
panels.description: Share of images that failed to caption. Blue below 1%, orange up to 5%, vermillion above.

panels.title: Active requests
panels.description: Requests being processed right now (in-progress gauge, Single + Bulk).

panels.title: Throughput by mode
panels.description: Images captioned per second (1 min rate). Bulk ZIP uploads show as sustained plateaus; single uploads as short blips.

panels.title: Inference latency p50 / p95 (histogram)
panels.description: Model inference time per image, from histogram buckets over 5 min. Solid = p95, dashed = p50.

panels.title: Average request vs preprocessing time (summary)
panels.description: Mean end-to-end request time and image decode time from the Summary's _sum / _count. Log scale because preprocessing is milliseconds while a bulk request is seconds to minutes.

panels.title: Inference latency distribution
panels.description: How many images fell into each inference-time bucket per minute. Brighter cells = more images. Viridis scale is colorblind-safe and prints in grayscale.

panels.title: Requests by client (last 15 min)
panels.description: Which client IP and browser session sent how many requests, split by mode (custom labels).

panels.title: Bulk job progress
panels.description: Images still waiting in the ZIP currently being processed. A falling staircase = a bulk job draining.

panels.title: Errors by type
panels.description: Failed images per 5 min, by mode and Python exception type.

panels.title: Average uploaded image size
panels.description: Mean image size per mode, from the histogram's _sum / _count. Larger images take longer to decode.

panels.title: Average caption length
panels.description: Mean words per generated caption, by mode.

panels.title: VM CPU vs captioning throughput
panels.description: Whole-VM CPU and the app process's CPU (left axis) against images/s (right axis). Bulk uploads should lift all three together.

panels.title: Memory: VM used vs app process
panels.description: RAM used by the whole VM, the captioning app's resident memory (model weights dominate), and total VM RAM as a ceiling.

panels.title: Disk I/O
panels.description: Bytes read from and written to disk per second across all VM disks.

panels.title: Root disk usage
panels.description: Share of the VM's root filesystem in use. Orange from 80%, vermillion from 90%.

panels.title: Load average vs cores
panels.description: 1 and 5 minute load average. Above the dashed core count means work is queuing for the CPU.
